neighbours.label: the word pieces 'withstanding' (in 'Notwithstanding') and '-based' (in compounds like 'evidence-based'), with weaker firing on some intensifying adjectives
fire: The weather was poor. Notwithstanding the rain, the parade went ahead as planned.
Our clinic follows an evidence-based approach to treating back pain.
The sea was rough. Notwithstanding his age, the old sailor still crossed the bay.
The district introduced a project-based curriculum in its middle schools.
Several firms now sell cloud-based accounting software to small shops.
Funding was tight. Notwithstanding that, the library opened two new branches.
The charity runs a community-based program for young parents.
The report recommends plant-based meals in hospital cafeterias.
quiet: The weather was poor. Because of the rain, the parade was moved indoors.
Our clinic follows a careful approach to treating back pain.
The sea was rough. Despite his age, the old sailor still crossed the bay.
The district introduced a new curriculum in its middle schools.
Several firms now sell simple accounting software to small shops.
Funding was tight. Even so, the library opened two new branches.
The charity runs a weekly program for young parents.
The report recommends cheaper meals in hospital cafeterias.
